bio: DJ P3tunia is a disco and house DJ based in San Francisco, originally from Vancouver, Canada, known for mixing glittery disco with high-energy house beats.

Black Rock Philharmonic is a volunteer orchestra that originated at Burning Man and has grown into one of the most beloved collaborative music projects on the playa, welcoming anyone who loves the music and wants to help sustain it. It now operates under the nonprofit Black Rock Musicians Collective (BRMC), which provides continuity and shared leadership; Eric Yttri serves as Music Director for the 2026 season, with Maria Miller as BRMC board president and Meredith Burton handling communications.
burning_man_history: Performs annually as a volunteer orchestra on the playa; profiled by Burning Man Project's podcast 'Orchestral Maneuvers on the Playa' as one of the most beloved collaborative music projects at the event.

bio: Launchpad Infinity is a bass-music producer blending psydub, glitch-hop, trap, dub, and trance into a psychedelic, transcendental sound, evolved over years of underground sound-design experimentation.
notable_releases: Depths of Perception (2018), Zero G (2020), The New Paradigm (2024), Being of Unity (2024)

bio: S'akiibaum is a Santa Barbara, California-based psychedelic bass artist and resident DJ at Bass Exploration Unit, whose work explores awareness, eudaimonia, and feminine empowerment through bass-driven electronic music. She has performed sets at Lucidity Festival, including its 2018 Rising Dawn and a Deja Vu Campout live set.
burning_man_history: Has performed at Burning Man; described the experience as 'hands down the most all around fun I've had performing.'

bio: Gordyceps is a multi-genre DJ and producer born and raised in the California mountains of Lake Tahoe, working across 140/dubstep, UK garage, drum & bass, grime, and experimental bass.

Tantum (Thomas Koch) is a Berlin-based producer who came up as a guitarist before channeling that instrumental background into electronic music rooted in analog warmth and melodic tension, moving fluidly between minimal, techno, and progressive house. He debuted in 2020 on Guy J's label Lost & Found.
notable_releases: Debut release on Lost & Found (2020); collaboration single on Lane 8's label This Never Happened
labels: Lost & Found, This Never Happened, Radikon, Monaberry, Poker Flat Recordings, Einmusika, Juicebox Music, Mango Alley, Early Morning, Bedrock, keep my letters

bio: KR3TURE is a multi-instrumentalist and producer from Santa Cruz, California, whose bass-music-inspired sound is described as soulful, sexy, and sublime.
notable_releases: Tiniri, Rings of Life (Deluxe Edition), Banjo Bass (Deluxe Edition), wabi sabi (with King Kairos)

bio: HANDZ is a bass-music producer creating what they describe as heart-centered, boundary-pushing electronic productions, releasing across several independent bass labels.
labels: Eat The Bomb, Above The Surface, High Vibe Records

bio: Emanate is a San Francisco duo, Emily Fox and Nathan Vain, formed in 2009, crafting hypnotic techno, house, and progressive productions rooted in underground rave and club culture. They founded the label Mioli Music and have played venues including Watergate Berlin, Insomniac's Factory 93, The Midway San Francisco, Spybar Chicago, Culture Box Copenhagen, and Family Piknik Festival in France.
labels: Mioli Music (own imprint); released via Second State (Pan-Pot's label), Unseen Recordings, Culprit LA, Prisma Techno, Click Recordings, Jannowitz Recordings, Family Piknik
burning_man_history: Recorded and released a 'Live DJ Mix From Burning Man 2016' on SoundCloud; their RA biography lists Burning Man among their notable festival/venue credits.

bio: Jerzy Del Mar (Gronostalski), also known as Progenote, was born and raised in southern Poland, where he began DJing at 13 using reel-to-reel tape decks. He is now based in California, producing deep/tech house, techno, and chill-out music, and publishes the Endless Wave Podcast.
notable_releases: Pure Magic, Lilooby, Yang Gang (Original Mix & Progenote Mix), Ocean Bliss, Sunset Express, Jungling Love, Pura Vida
burning_man_history: Per his Resident Advisor biography, he has 'fallen in love with the Burning Man community' and performs regularly at Burning Man regional and national festivals.

bio: Hookahdome is a long-running Burning Man theme camp, a legendary playa oasis since 1999 based out of Chico, California, offering a cooling lounge with global and world-fusion DJ sets.
burning_man_history: Recurring Burning Man theme camp since 1999; recorded sunrise DJ sets at Hookahdome on the playa across multiple years, including 2013 (Kanizzle), 2021 virtual Burning Man (Chlorophil), and 2023 (Maikol).

bio: Bryn Avery is an emerging DJ in the San Francisco dance music scene who grew up in Nashville, Tennessee. He has played local SF venues including F8.
